cutoff: Asia/Shanghai decision timestamp; EOD observation is not deemed published at 15:00 without source evidence

tier_0.definition: raw fields with verified semantics, source identity, dated applicability, first publication/revision history and frozen source version
tier_0.current_admission: blocked for bars by units/availability and for status/limits by historical conflict/version gaps

tier_1.definition: deterministic derivations using only admitted Tier 0 data with event_time and published_at <= decision_at
tier_1.current_admission: design only; not computed in this task

tier_2.definition: context needing explicit first_available_at, revision_at, original snapshot and dated membership

tier_3.definition: post-hoc/current-knowledge classifications or later-edited records without a frozen at-t snapshot

guard: reject missing or timezone-naive publication/revision times, future-published revisions, effective-date gaps, unknown source version, unknown units and conflicting source rows; preserve UNKNOWN and do not backfill current knowledge
known_stage0_state: AmazingDataBridge sets availability_verified=false; observed kline_time is bar date, not publication time; current factor refresh does not prove historical PIT
negative_fixture: record first_published_at=2024-07-05T09:00:00+08:00 cannot be used for decision_at=2024-07-04T15:00:00+08:00 even when effective_from=2024-07-04
